name: Arlington
description: Arlington, often called Oklahoma Rummy, is a complex contract rummy game played over seven distinct hands. It features an aggressive 'wild-stealing' mechanic and a unique 'Offering' phase after every turn, making it much more interactive than standard Draw-and-Discard rummy games.

content.text: Arlington, often called Oklahoma Rummy, is a complex contract rummy game played over seven distinct hands. It features an aggressive 'wild-stealing' mechanic and a unique 'Offering' phase after every turn, making it much more interactive than standard Draw-and-Discard rummy games.

Arlington emerged alongside other contract rummy games like Phase 10 and Liverpool Rummy in the mid-20th century. It became a staple in Oklahoma and the American Midwest specifically for its high-scoring potential.
105 cards (2 x 52 + 1 Joker). All 2s and the Joker are wild.
Each player is dealt 13 cards. The remainder forms the stock pile. The top card is flipped to start the discard pile.

items.text: Arlington Queen: The Queen of Spades is worth 50 points (same as a Joker) but is NOT wild.
Short Arlington: Played over 6 hands instead of 7 to speed up play.
